demos/ui-entrance/research-card-stack-sc.mechanism: Thirteen fixed paper cards enter every 12f, compress briefly on landing, drift into a depth stack with blur/dimming; only current top card exposes abstract body while background grid moves.

demos/rhythm/rhythm-interrupt-moves/Jump.mechanism: One faux dashboard hard-jumps at f35 and f70 from 1x to1.6x to2.6x around a measured fixture card, with two-frame dim tick each time.

demos/rhythm/rhythm-interrupt-moves/Stro.mechanism: A faux page slowly pushes while nine exact two-frame blackouts increase in frequency; after the last blackout it hard-jumps to a target-card zoom and settles.

demos/rhythm/rhythm-interrupt-moves/Stro.bad_fit: Frequent black frames impair reading and may pose photosensitivity risk; should not be a default educational explainer or imply true audio crescendo.

demos/data/ring-diagram-annotation-revea.bad_fit: Inward arrows/rings alone cannot show a real mechanism or guarantee the explanatory copy fits.

demos/effects/riso-print-hits/RisoBeatPu.mechanism: At four fixed beats the full frame pumps for one instant while two colored title plates misregister with decaying oscillation and beat markers stay on.

template/src/aifl/live/SceneDetail.tsx.controls: accent prop; camera f0-75, rows from layout, cue12+9i and 12f landing.

demos/effects/scan-bracket-sweep/ScanBra.mechanism: A skeleton document pops in, four corner brackets settle, and a thin scan line plus directional fade tail traverses the fixed page five times.
demos/effects/scan-bracket-sweep/ScanBra.controls: Fixed 300x178 bone document, five passes with end pauses and normalized t .17-.95.
demos/effects/scan-bracket-sweep/ScanBra.variable_inputs_needed: True source page/target read task and real scan reason if interpreted as searching.

demos/effects/scanline-annotate-focus/Sc.mechanism: One scan line moves down a fixed fake page and triggers six manually bounded reticles/labels after crossing each box; top status increments and ends COMPLETE.
demos/effects/scanline-annotate-focus/Sc.controls: Hardcoded Acme layout, six target boxes and scan-derived trigger ordering.
demos/effects/scanline-annotate-focus/Sc.variable_inputs_needed: Real page pixels/boxes, annotations and genuine completion basis.

demos/effects/scanline-assemble-flyin/Sc.mechanism: A scan line crossing seven fixed page slots triggers shell elements flying in from assigned edges and leaves a completed synthetic page.
demos/effects/scanline-assemble-flyin/Sc.controls: Hardcoded Acme layout and seven plans/times derived from source y positions.
demos/effects/scanline-assemble-flyin/Sc.variable_inputs_needed: Actual page components, precise slot coordinates and verified final text.
demos/effects/scanline-assemble-flyin/Sc.media_or_dependency: Self-drawn placeholder site and status counter.
demos/effects/scanline-assemble-flyin/Sc.bad_fit: An assembled page does not prove an upstream website was loaded or built.

demos/typography/scramble/Scramble.tsx.mechanism: A fixed monospace phrase cycles seeded random glyphs every two frames, then locks characters left-to-right with brief blue flash.

demos/data/scroll-brake-moves/BrakeRetic.mechanism: Another fixed long list accelerates, overshoots 30px, brakes, then four corner reticles lock onto row 30 while highlight and version label enter.

demos/data/scroll-brake-moves/ChangelogS.variable_inputs_needed: Actual page/list height and row bounds, source pixels, target read unit and settled cue window.
demos/data/scroll-brake-moves/ChangelogS.media_or_dependency: Fixtures rows, no real changelog/official page.

demos/interaction/segmented-thumb-hero/S.mechanism: An oversized two-option segmented control and cursor enter, click occurs, white thumb slides to second option and target icon pops after arrival.
demos/interaction/segmented-thumb-hero/S.controls: Fixed Ask/Computer options, click f48, thumb f52-60 and postslide spring.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/BlackC.mechanism: A source page fades to black, a seven-word letterpress dark title builds word by word and holds, then a different page fades in after title retirement.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/BlackC.variable_inputs_needed: Authorized A/B stills, correct chapter sentence, branded color/reading duration and frequency cap.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/DarkTu.mechanism: First long-page still slides left into a short dark moving tunnel; second still comes from screen right along the same motion direction, scaling .6→1 and deblurring into a settled hold.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/DarkTu.variable_inputs_needed: Authorized A/B visual windows with consistent axis, justified high-energy cut and destination read hold.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/FocusH.mechanism: Two crops of one fixed long page trade focus: upper section drifts/blur-fades out and lower section comes from opposite offset with blur/opacity crossover, then holds sharp.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/FocusH.controls: PAGE_H1746, crop offsets -180/-900, A f24-40, B f26-42, 8px blur and ±50/60px drifts, f42-120 hold.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/MaskWi.mechanism: A fixed project card rectangle expands into a fullscreen clipped window; inner crop of the same project page counter-scales into view as the card face fades.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/MaskWi.controls: Card geometry read from live-layout JSON, initial viewport offset180, f40-85 expansion, inner scale .42→1, f85-120 hold.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/Portal.mechanism: A fixture card grows into a full-screen window containing a far dashboard and two near cards at deliberately restrained parallax scale; all motion settles by f73.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/Portal.controls: Fixed card rect1180,620,480,320, expansion f25-65, inner scale .42→1, spread f40-73 near .3/far .08, hold to150.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/WhipBr.mechanism: A horizontal rail of nine card stills accelerates through 70 percent travel in twelve frames, then eases the final 30 percent across 48 frames to an enlarged target card.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/WhipBr.controls: Hardcoded target index9, 460px card+60px gap, f30-42 fast/f42-90 brake, CameraMotionBlur shutter200/samples20, f90-130 hold.

demos/transition/shot-transitions/WhipPa.mechanism: One project page is duplicated as upper and lower crops at world x0/x2880; an eight-frame horizontal camera whip jumps between them under motion blur.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/WhipPa.controls: Fixed 2880px swing f35-43, shutter200/samples20, f43-120 destination hold.
demos/transition/shot-transitions/WhipPa.variable_inputs_needed: Source page dimensions and crop windows, actual two semantic regions, endpoint hold and compatible blur runtime.

demos/ui-entrance/skeleton-reveal/Skelet.mechanism: A jittering doodle facade swaps to a skeleton chat UI, skeleton rows slide in, then individual synthetic names/messages develop word by word while camera pushes.
demos/ui-entrance/skeleton-reveal/Skelet.controls: Hardcoded four fake messages, doodle swap f32 and text reveal f80 onward; seeded wobble changes each 5 frames.
demos/ui-entrance/skeleton-reveal/Skelet.variable_inputs_needed: Real authorized chat/text, sender identity, word cues and actual UI/voice if claimed.
demos/ui-entrance/skeleton-reveal/Skelet.media_or_dependency: Self-drawn fake Slack-like interface with fabricated dialogue.
demos/ui-entrance/skeleton-reveal/Skelet.bad_fit: Skeleton bars or fake coworker messages cannot be presented as genuine conversation evidence.

demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Impact.mechanism: One main card lands, sends a timed expansion ring and particles, and pushes two neighboring cards when the calculated ring front reaches them.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Impact.controls: Fixed impact f20, neighbor response f23, 14 particles and 40f damped return.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Impact.variable_inputs_needed: Real separable objects, measured relative positions and explicit symbolic-vs-physical meaning.

demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Kanada.mechanism: One fake card flies in with extreme perspective/rotation/scale and settles with short yaw overshoot and tiny shake.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Kanada.controls: Fixed f0-18 arrival, f18-22 settle and specific 520x340 card slot.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Kanada.variable_inputs_needed: Actual art/text layer that remains legible after settling and measured origin.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/Kanada.bad_fit: Extreme fisheye motion cannot carry a source reading task during its distorted frames.

demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/ScoreS.mechanism: A fixed KPI card drops into center with scale/rotation compression while ring, dust and screen shake fire at landing.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/ScoreS.controls: Fixed impact f14, settle through f30 and fabricated +247 percent KPI.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/ScoreS.variable_inputs_needed: Verified KPI value/source and a proportionate emphasis beat.
demos/effects/slam-entrance-moves/ScoreS.bad_fit: The sample +247 percent is not a business or student result and must never be reused as fact.

demos/rhythm/smear-multiples/SmearMultip.mechanism: One fixture card rushes between slots while four translucent delayed replicas sample its prior positions and then converge/fade as body settles.
demos/rhythm/smear-multiples/SmearMultip.controls: Body moves f25-37 across900px with27px overshoot, settles f43, ghost offsets k*2frames when speed>25px/f, convergence f35-38.
demos/rhythm/smear-multiples/SmearMultip.variable_inputs_needed: Actual stable main object and path, visual-only ghost styling, source/target slots.

demos/rhythm/smear-multiples/SmearMultip.bad_fit: Four visible replicas must not be interpreted as five conserved objects or duplicated source records.

demos/camera/space-camera-moves/DroneDiv.mechanism: A page-like world tilts upright, scales from distant overview and translates toward a hardcoded hero center under one travel parameter, with a shadow shrinking as it lands.

demos/camera/space-camera-moves/DroneDiv.variable_inputs_needed: Target object's measured center, independent page/hero visual and correctly timed still read state.

demos/rhythm/spectrum-morph-ui/SpectrumM.mechanism: A 720px title underline splits into 28 seeded pseudo-FFT bars with low-to-high envelope, dances and collapses back to one solid line.
demos/rhythm/spectrum-morph-ui/SpectrumM.controls: Fixed split f25-33, pseudo wave until f89, collapse f89-101, LAUNCH WEEK title, no audio analysis.
demos/rhythm/spectrum-morph-ui/SpectrumM.variable_inputs_needed: Actual soundtrack frequency data if presented as spectrum, or explicit abstract decorative role; owned title.

demos/rhythm/spectrum-morph-ui/SpectrumM.bad_fit: Bars are not a measured spectrum or evidence of beat synchronization despite their shape.

demos/rhythm/speed-ramp-freeze/FreezeAnn.mechanism: A rail of repeated page-card textures freezes source-frame remap at 45 for 55 output frames while a roughened marker ellipse/arrow draws around one target, then unfreezes faster.
demos/rhythm/speed-ramp-freeze/FreezeAnn.controls: Remap output f0/45/100/135 to source0/45/45/94, target index5, annotation f52-66 and fade f96-104.

demos/rhythm/speed-ramp-freeze/FreezeAnn.bad_fit: Frozen rendered card list does not prove the target was inspected; annotation placement follows hardcoded geometry and repeated rail images are not unique records.

demos/rhythm/speed-ramp-freeze/SpeedRamp.variable_inputs_needed: Real ordered subject sequence, source-time mapping and accurate target passage, compatible blur runtime.

demos/typography/type-assembly-moves/Tra.bad_fit: Per-character spacing constant depends on exact font/word; it does not encode a factual expansion or breathing process.

demos/typography/type-rhythm-sync/Karaok.variable_inputs_needed: True aligned voice/word timestamps, exact script text and phrase-level reading plan; test normal speed.

demos/typography/type-rhythm-sync/Karaok.bad_fit: Hardcoded timing is not word-level alignment to original narration and may make semantic emphasis precede/follow spoken words.

demos/typography/typewriter-moves/Termin.mechanism: A faux terminal types acme deploy --prod at two frames per character, pauses, then command line rushes into a hard cut to a settled dashboard.

demos/typography/typewriter-moves/Termin.media_or_dependency: FakeDashboard and hand-drawn terminal, no command execution.
demos/typography/typewriter-moves/Termin.bad_fit: Typing deploy --prod and cutting to a dashboard must not imply actual deployment, terminal action or production release.

demos/typography/typewriter-moves/Typewr.mechanism: A fixed-width line types just a dashboard, visibly hesitates, backspaces to just, then types your command center and retires its cursor.

demos/typography/typewriter-moves/Typewr.bad_fit: This edits on-screen copy only; cannot claim a user actually revised a document or that command-center capability exists.

demos/typography/typing-code-block/Typin.mechanism: The same four token-colored code lines reveal side by side: left as staggered whole lines, right as flat character stream retaining token colors and square cursor highlight.

demos/typography/typing-code-block/Typin.variable_inputs_needed: Verified exact code or clearly fictional snippet, syntax token ranges, line wrap and readable target scale.
demos/typography/typing-code-block/Typin.media_or_dependency: Pure in-file code sample, no execution/runtime trace.
demos/typography/typing-code-block/Typin.bad_fit: Typed code does not prove it compiled or ran; tiny panel text cannot carry a production code audit without enlargement.

demos/outro/ui-strip-away-outro/UiStripA.mechanism: A cursor targets faux Publish, editor layers evaporate outside-in on staggered 14f exits, button survives alone on black and moves center, then placeholder wordmark takes over.

demos/outro/ui-strip-away-outro/UiStripA.variable_inputs_needed: Actual authorized editor state, accurately labeled action/status, stable button identity and approved outro brand.
demos/outro/ui-strip-away-outro/UiStripA.media_or_dependency: Fake editor/Card and text only, no real publishing API.
demos/outro/ui-strip-away-outro/UiStripA.bad_fit: Clicking a fake Publish button must not be presented as real publication or account state; UI disappearance is not completion proof.

demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/IconFlipBl.mechanism: A smile-laptop icon anticipates, compresses to a Y-flip edge, then five petals spring outward into a flower-like mark while a wordmark reveals by character with directional blur.

demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/IconFlipBl.variable_inputs_needed: Authorized old icon/new logo artwork, stable morph correspondence and genuine brand rights.
demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/IconFlipBl.media_or_dependency: Hand-drawn icon/flower and literal third-party wordmark, not an approved logo file.
demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/IconFlipBl.bad_fit: Do not reuse third-party branding or imply the icon and logo are same organization's real identity; this is a shape-change reference only.

demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/InputMorph.mechanism: A faux send input is clicked, its text flies away, the input rectangle shrinks into a horizontal pill while three independent shapes drop to form an abstract flower-petal logo cluster.
demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/InputMorph.controls: Fixed click f22, text f26-38, morph from f34, drops f56/70/84, breathing from f108; fixed geometry/text.
demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/InputMorph.variable_inputs_needed: Real or clearly fictional chat input, verified send state if claimed, owned logo design and stable geometry.

demos/outro/ui-to-brand-morph/InputMorph.bad_fit: Text flying away is not message delivery; code explicitly says abstract non-Slack petal, so cannot claim true Slack mark.

demos/ui-entrance/value-stagger-gradient.mechanism: Sixteen bars enter with both staggered timing and index-based height/hue/blur gradients; a second pulse radiates from center with center-weighted amplitude.

demos/ui-entrance/value-stagger-gradient.bad_fit: A decorative color/height gradient must not masquerade as factual statistical comparison.

demos/typography/vertical-word-roll-blur.mechanism: A masked three-row window scrolls Apps/Teams/Data/Everyone through center with blur/opacity by distance and accent color only on centered term.

demos/typography/vertical-word-roll-blur.bad_fit: Rolling category names do not show an app truly serves all categories; Everyone is an especially broad unsupported claim.

demos/interaction/voice-waveform-live/Vo.mechanism: Sixty-four synthetic bars scroll under a microphone capsule according to deterministic value noise and two hardcoded speaking envelopes, then collapse on a simulated submit.

demos/interaction/voice-waveform-live/Vo.variable_inputs_needed: Actual PCM amplitude/voice consent and verified cue alignment if presenting real speech, plus true submit state.
demos/interaction/voice-waveform-live/Vo.media_or_dependency: No external audio is read; microphone emoji and voice trace are illustrative.
demos/interaction/voice-waveform-live/Vo.bad_fit: Cannot call this a live waveform or evidence of recording/submission without real audio/data.

demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Bent.mechanism: A 3x2 dark bento wall reveals cells in order: each border traces first, then card content brightens/lifts; full wall receives a small final push.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Bent.controls: Fixed six slots, 12f stagger, f96-121 final push.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Bent.variable_inputs_needed: Actual six distinct features or objects, per-cell assets and one final attention target.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Bent.bad_fit: Six lit cards are not six verified capabilities or readable simultaneous explanations.

demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Grid.mechanism: A 3x3 card wall flips back to front along diagonal wave delays; each card has CSS-3D front/back faces and final card overshoots slightly.

demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Grid.variable_inputs_needed: Actual separate front/back art for each stable ID and selected cell for reading.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Grid.bad_fit: Flipping nine blanks does not reveal nine new validated facts.

demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Wire.variable_inputs_needed: Matched exact wireframe/solid scene geometry and source content.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Wire.media_or_dependency: FakeDashboard fixture and synthetic seeded chart line.
demos/ui-entrance/wall-reveal-moves/Wire.bad_fit: If line plan and real page differ, scan implies a false construction identity.

demos/transition/white-flash-logo-simpli.mechanism: An animated rainbow-text placeholder is overexposed by a white sheet, then a simplified three-color flat placeholder wordmark appears at slight scale settle.

demos/transition/white-flash-logo-simpli.variable_inputs_needed: Actual licensed before/after brand art, approved simplification relationship and flash accessibility.
demos/transition/white-flash-logo-simpli.media_or_dependency: DesignStage and CSS gradients, no actual brand files.
demos/transition/white-flash-logo-simpli.bad_fit: A graphic simplification transition does not authorize redesigning a locked brand or claim two brand states are the same real asset.

demos/transition/wipe-transitions/Blinds.mechanism: Twelve 160px vertical viewport slices replace a dashboard A crop with aligned B crop using complementary scaleX fractions; moving seams are drawn in three contrast layers, then strip wrappers unload.

demos/transition/wipe-transitions/Blinds.bad_fit: Staggered slices are an occlusion edit, not proof twelve independent state changes or object continuity.

demos/transition/wipe-transitions/ClockW.mechanism: A seventy-two-segment polar polygon clip exposes B clockwise from 12 o'clock while a high-contrast radial line tracks the edge; A and mask unload after completion.
demos/transition/wipe-transitions/ClockW.controls: Fixed center960,540, radius1400, 72 segments, 30-90f linear full revolution, line fades to f96, f96-150 still.
demos/transition/wipe-transitions/ClockW.variable_inputs_needed: Actual A/B full frames, focal center placement and reason for clock-direction edit.
demos/transition/wipe-transitions/ClockW.bad_fit: A circular wipe is not an elapsed-time timeline or measured progress indicator merely because it resembles a clock.

demos/typography/word-relay-filmstrip/Wo.variable_inputs_needed: Actual page images for each verb, matching semantic page-to-action mapping, page identity/crop and right-line typography metrics.
demos/typography/word-relay-filmstrip/Wo.media_or_dependency: All six cards are synthetic skeletons, including MRI-like placeholder; no real medical/source content.
demos/typography/word-relay-filmstrip/Wo.bad_fit: A pseudo MRI thumbnail and Computer researches cannot be presented as actual diagnostic/medical activity or verified capabilities.

demos/typography/word-relay-geometry/Wor.variable_inputs_needed: Evidence for comparative claims, approved wording and consistent visual geometry/hold.
